segments.src: Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) ditutup di level 6.095,86 pada akhir September.
segments.tr: The Indonesia Stock Exchange Composite Index (IHSG) closed at the level of 6,095.86 at the end of September.

segments.src: Memasuki Oktober, sejumlah analis memperkirakan pergerakannya berada di kisaran 5.900–6.500.
segments.tr: Entering October, a number of analysts predict its movement will be in the range of 5,900–6,500.

segments.src: Di tengah rentang tersebut, perhatian pelaku pasar juga tertuju pada agenda November, yaitu pengumuman keputusan dari penyedia indeks global MSCI.
segments.tr: Amidst this range, market participants' attention is also focused on the November agenda, which is the announcement of the decision from the global index provider MSCI.

segments.src: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara kerja penilaian indeks global dan hal-hal yang sebaiknya diperhatikan investor ritel.
segments.tr: This article explains how global index assessment works and things that retail investors should pay attention to.

segments.src: ## Posisi IHSG: Angka dan Rentang Perkiraan
segments.tr: ## IHSG Position: Figures and Estimated Range

segments.src: Penutupan IHSG di 6.095,86 menjadi titik acuan awal bagi pergerakan Oktober.
segments.tr: The closure of the IHSG at 6,095.86 serves as an initial reference point for October's movement.

segments.src: Rentang perkiraan 5.900–6.500 menunjukkan dua hal:
segments.tr: The estimated range of 5,900–6,500 indicates two things:

segments.src: - **Ruang gerak yang cukup lebar.** Selisih sekitar 600 poin berarti pasar masih menimbang banyak faktor, mulai dari kondisi ekonomi domestik, arah suku bunga, nilai tukar rupiah, hingga sentimen global.
segments.tr: - **Sukup lebar ruang gerak.** A difference of about 600 points means the market is still weighing many factors, ranging from domestic economic conditions, interest rate directions, the rupiah exchange rate, to global sentiment.

segments.src: - **Ketidakpastian tetap ada.** Rentang proyeksi pada dasarnya adalah skenario, bukan target yang pasti tercapai. Harga bisa bergerak di luar rentang tersebut bila ada kejutan.
segments.tr: - **Uncertainty remains.** The projection range is essentially a scenario, not a target that is definitely achieved. Prices can move outside that range if there are surprises.

segments.src: Bagi investor ritel, angka-angka ini lebih tepat dipakai sebagai gambaran suasana pasar daripada sinyal untuk bertindak tergesa-gesa.
segments.tr: For retail investors, these numbers are more appropriately used as a picture of market sentiment rather than a signal to act hastily.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu MSCI dan Mengapa Dicermati?
segments.tr: ## What Is MSCI and Why Is It Monitored?

segments.src: MSCI adalah penyedia indeks yang dipakai secara luas oleh manajer investasi di seluruh dunia sebagai tolok ukur (*benchmark*).
segments.tr: MSCI is an index provider widely used by investment managers around the world as a benchmark (*benchmark*).

segments.src: Banyak dana kelolaan, termasuk reksa dana dan produk berbasis indeks (ETF), mengacu pada indeks MSCI.
segments.tr: Many managed funds, including mutual funds and index-based products (ETFs), refer to the MSCI index.

segments.src: Karena itu, perubahan komposisi indeks dapat memengaruhi aliran dana asing.
segments.tr: Therefore, changes in the index composition can affect foreign capital flows.

segments.src: Secara umum, MSCI mengelompokkan pasar saham negara ke dalam kategori seperti *developed market*, *emerging market*, dan *frontier market*.
segments.tr: In general, MSCI groups country stock markets into categories such as *developed market*, *emerging market*, and *frontier market*.

segments.src: Di dalam tiap negara, saham dipilih berdasarkan beberapa kriteria.
segments.tr: Within each country, stocks are selected based on several criteria.

segments.src: ### Kriteria Umum Penilaian Indeks
segments.tr: ### General Index Assessment Criteria

segments.src: Meski detail teknisnya dapat berubah dari waktu ke waktu, faktor yang lazim diperhatikan antara lain:
segments.tr: Although technical details may change from time to time, factors commonly observed include:

segments.src: 1. **Kapitalisasi pasar.** Ukuran perusahaan, biasanya dihitung dari porsi saham yang bisa diperdagangkan publik.
segments.tr: 1. **Market capitalization.** Company size, usually calculated from the portion of shares that can be traded publicly.

segments.src: 2. **Free float.** Persentase saham yang benar-benar beredar di publik, bukan dipegang pengendali atau pihak strategis.
segments.tr: 2. **Free float.** The percentage of shares that are truly circulating in public, not held by controllers or strategic parties.

segments.src: 3. **Likuiditas.** Seberapa aktif saham diperdagangkan, sehingga investor besar dapat membeli atau menjual tanpa menggerakkan harga secara berlebihan.
segments.tr: 3. **Liquidity.** How actively stocks are traded, so that large investors can buy or sell without moving prices excessively.

segments.src: 4. **Aksesibilitas pasar.** Kemudahan investor asing masuk dan keluar, termasuk aturan kepemilikan, infrastruktur perdagangan, dan transparansi informasi.
segments.tr: 4. **Market accessibility.** The ease of foreign investors entering and exiting, including ownership rules, trading infrastructure, and information transparency.

segments.src: ### Jenis Keputusan yang Biasa Muncul
segments.tr: ### Types of Decisions That Usually Appear

segments.src: Dalam tinjauan berkala, MSCI dapat mengumumkan saham yang **masuk**, **keluar**, atau **berubah bobotnya** dalam indeks.
segments.tr: In periodic reviews, MSCI can announce stocks that **enter**, **exit**, or **change weight** in the index.

segments.src: Ada juga tinjauan terhadap klasifikasi pasar secara keseluruhan.
segments.tr: There are also reviews of the overall market classification.

segments.src: Pengumuman umumnya diikuti masa transisi sebelum perubahan berlaku efektif.
segments.tr: Announcements are generally followed by a transition period before changes take effect.

segments.src: ## Bagaimana Keputusan Indeks Global Memengaruhi Pasar?
segments.tr: ## How Global Index Decisions Affect the Market?

segments.src: Mekanismenya cukup sederhana:
segments.tr: The mechanism is quite simple:

segments.src: - Dana yang mengikuti indeks (pasif) perlu menyesuaikan portofolio ketika komposisi indeks berubah. Saham yang bobotnya naik berpotensi mendapat pembelian tambahan, sedangkan yang bobotnya turun berpotensi dijual.
segments.tr: - Funds following the index (passive) need to adjust their portfolios when the index composition changes. Stocks with rising weights have the potential to get additional purchases, while those with dropping weights have the potential to be sold.

segments.src: - Dana aktif juga sering memakai indeks sebagai pembanding, sehingga keputusan alokasi mereka ikut terpengaruh.
segments.tr: - Active funds also often use the index as a comparison, so their allocation decisions are affected as well.

segments.src: - Sentimen pasar kerap bergerak lebih dulu daripada keputusan resmi, karena pelaku pasar berusaha mengantisipasi hasilnya.
segments.tr: - Market sentiment often moves ahead of official decisions, because market participants try to anticipate the results.

segments.src: Namun perlu diingat, dampaknya tidak selalu searah atau seketika.
segments.tr: However, keep in mind that the impact is not always directional or instantaneous.

segments.src: Sering kali pasar sudah "memperhitungkan" ekspektasi sebelum pengumuman, sehingga reaksi saat keputusan keluar bisa jauh lebih kecil, atau bahkan berlawanan dari dugaan.
segments.tr: Often the market has "priced in" expectations before the announcement, so the reaction when the decision comes out can be much smaller, or even opposite to the guess.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Sebaiknya Diperhatikan Investor Ritel
segments.tr: ## Things Retail Investors Should Pay Attention To

segments.src: ### 1. Bedakan Antara Informasi dan Spekulasi
segments.tr: ### 1. Differentiate Between Information and Speculation

segments.src: Jelang pengumuman, beredar banyak prediksi di media sosial dan grup percakapan.
segments.tr: Ahead of the announcement, many predictions circulate on social media and chat groups.

segments.src: Rujuklah sumber resmi seperti pengumuman MSCI, keterbukaan informasi Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI), dan laporan emiten.
segments.tr: Refer to official sources such as MSCI announcements, Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) information disclosure, and issuer reports.

segments.src: Hindari mengambil keputusan hanya berdasarkan kabar yang belum terverifikasi.
segments.tr: Avoid making decisions solely based on unverified news.

segments.src: ### 2. Waspadai Volatilitas Jangka Pendek
segments.tr: ### 2. Beware of Short-Term Volatility

segments.src: Pergerakan harga di sekitar tanggal pengumuman bisa tajam.
segments.tr: Price movements around the announcement date can be sharp.

segments.src: Jika Anda berinvestasi jangka panjang, fluktuasi singkat tidak selalu mengubah nilai fundamental perusahaan.
segments.tr: If you invest long-term, brief fluctuations do not always change the company's fundamental value.

segments.src: ### 3. Fokus pada Fundamental
segments.tr: ### 3. Focus on Fundamentals

segments.src: Kinerja laba, struktur utang, prospek bisnis, dan tata kelola perusahaan tetap menjadi dasar utama menilai saham.
segments.tr: Earnings performance, debt structure, business prospects, and corporate governance remain the main basis for assessing stocks.

segments.src: Status dalam indeks global hanyalah salah satu faktor pendukung, bukan jaminan kenaikan harga.
segments.tr: Status in global indices is just one supporting factor, not a guarantee of price increases.

segments.src: ### 4. Kelola Risiko dan Diversifikasi
segments.tr: ### 4. Manage Risk and Diversification

segments.src: Jangan menaruh seluruh dana pada satu atau dua saham yang diperkirakan terdampak keputusan indeks.
segments.tr: Do not put all funds in one or two stocks estimated to be affected by index decisions.

segments.src: Sebarkan investasi lintas sektor dan sesuaikan dengan profil risiko serta tujuan keuangan Anda.
segments.tr: Spread investments across sectors and adjust to your risk profile and financial goals.

segments.src: ### 5. Gunakan Dana yang Siap Menanggung Risiko
segments.tr: ### 5. Use Funds Prepared to Bear Risks

segments.src: Hanya investasikan dana yang tidak Anda perlukan dalam waktu dekat.
segments.tr: Only invest funds that you do not need in the near future.

segments.src: Hindari berutang untuk membeli saham, apalagi demi mengejar momentum.
segments.tr: Avoid borrowing to buy shares, let alone to chase momentum.

segments.src: ### 6. Pantau Faktor Lain di Luar MSCI
segments.tr: ### 6. Monitor Other Factors Beyond MSCI

segments.src: Selain agenda indeks global, pergerakan IHSG dipengaruhi data inflasi, kebijakan Bank Indonesia, nilai tukar rupiah, harga komoditas, serta kebijakan bank sentral negara besar.
segments.tr: In addition to global index agendas, IHSG movements are influenced by inflation data, Bank Indonesia policies, the rupiah exchange rate, commodity prices, and policies of major country central banks.

segments.src: Melihat gambaran utuh membantu menghindari kesimpulan yang terlalu sempit.
segments.tr: Seeing the complete picture helps avoid overly narrow conclusions.

segments.src: ## Skenario yang Perlu Dipahami
segments.tr: ## Scenarios to Understand

segments.src: Alih-alih menebak satu hasil, investor dapat berpikir dalam skenario:
segments.tr: Instead of guessing a single outcome, investors can think in scenarios:

segments.src: | Skenario | Kemungkinan dampak | Sikap yang masuk akal |
segments.tr: | Scenario | Potential Impact | Sensible Attitude |

segments.src: | Keputusan sesuai ekspektasi pasar | Reaksi harga relatif terbatas | Tetap pada rencana investasi |
segments.tr: | Decision matches market expectations | Price reaction is relatively limited | Stick to investment plan |

segments.src: | Keputusan lebih positif dari dugaan | Sentimen membaik, namun kenaikan bisa berbalik bila hanya bersifat sesaat | Hindari euforia dan kejar harga |
segments.tr: | Decision is more positive than expected | Sentiment improves, but gains can reverse if only temporary | Avoid euphoria and chasing prices |

segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.tr: The IHSG which is around the 6,000 level with an estimated range of 5,900–6,500 for October indicates a market still searching for direction.

segments.src: Keputusan MSCI pada November menambah satu faktor yang dicermati investor asing karena menyangkut cara dunia menilai dan mengalokasikan dana ke pasar saham Indonesia.
segments.tr: The MSCI decision in November adds one factor watched by foreign investors because it concerns how the world evaluates and allocates funds to the Indonesian stock market.

segments.src: Bagi investor ritel, pelajaran terpentingnya adalah memahami mekanismenya, bukan menebak hasilnya.
segments.tr: For retail investors, the most important lesson is to understand the mechanism, not guess the outcome.

segments.src: Pegang rencana investasi, rujuk sumber resmi, jaga diversifikasi, dan kelola risiko dengan disiplin.
segments.tr: Stick to the investment plan, refer to official sources, maintain diversification, and manage risk with discipline.

segments.tr: That way, you remain calm in facing market dynamics, whatever decision is announced.

id-20261017-news-2.title: Energy Subsidies and Compensation Reaches Rp376.8 Trillion Through September: How Heavy is the Burden of the ICP Surge and Rupiah Depreciation on the State Budget?

segments.src: Realisasi subsidi dan kompensasi energi hingga September 2026 tercatat sebesar **Rp376,8 triliun**, atau sekitar **84,3 persen** dari pagu APBN 2026.
segments.tr: The realization of energy subsidies and compensation through September 2026 was recorded at **Rp376.8 trillion**, or about **84.3 percent** of the 2026 State Budget ceiling.

segments.src: Di saat yang sama, harga minyak mentah Indonesia (*Indonesian Crude Price*/ICP) berada di kisaran **US$112 per barel**, jauh di atas asumsi makro APBN sebesar **US$70 per barel**.
segments.tr: At the same time, the Indonesian Crude Price (ICP) hovered around **US$112 per barrel**, well above the State Budget macro assumption of **US$70 per barrel**.

segments.src: Selisih yang lebar ini membuat banyak pihak bertanya: seberapa kuat APBN menahan tekanan hingga akhir tahun?
segments.tr: This wide gap leaves many wondering: how strong is the State Budget in withstanding the pressure until the end of the year?

segments.src: Artikel ini merangkum komponen subsidi dan kompensasi energi, cara kerja sensitivitas APBN terhadap harga minyak dan nilai tukar, serta pilihan kebijakan yang tersedia bagi pemerintah.
segments.tr: This article summarizes the components of energy subsidies and compensation, how State Budget sensitivity to oil prices and exchange rates works, and the policy options available to the government.

segments.src: Angka yang dipakai bersumber dari data realisasi yang disebutkan di atas.
segments.tr: The figures used are sourced from the realization data mentioned above.

segments.src: Perhitungan lain bersifat ilustratif dan dapat berubah mengikuti data resmi terbaru.
segments.tr: Other calculations are illustrative and subject to change following the latest official data.

segments.src: ## Membaca Angka: Apa Arti 84,3 Persen?
segments.tr: ## Reading the Numbers: What Does 84.3 Percent Mean?

segments.src: Jika Rp376,8 triliun setara 84,3 persen pagu, maka pagu subsidi dan kompensasi energi dalam APBN 2026 berada di kisaran Rp447 triliun.
segments.tr: If Rp376.8 trillion equals 84.3 percent of the ceiling, then the energy subsidy and compensation ceiling in the 2026 State Budget is around Rp447 trillion.

segments.src: Artinya, tersisa ruang sekitar Rp70 triliun untuk tiga bulan terakhir tahun ini.
segments.tr: This means there is a remaining room of about Rp70 trillion for the last three months of the year.

segments.src: Dalam kondisi normal, belanja energi cenderung merata sepanjang tahun.
segments.tr: Under normal conditions, energy spending tends to be evenly distributed throughout the year.

segments.src: Rata-rata bulanan hingga September berada di kisaran Rp42 triliun.
segments.tr: The monthly average through September is around Rp42 trillion.

segments.src: Jika pola ini berlanjut, kebutuhan untuk Oktober sampai Desember bisa mendekati Rp126 triliun, sehingga berpotensi melampaui sisa pagu.
segments.tr: If this pattern continues, the demand for October to December could approach Rp126 trillion, potentially exceeding the remaining ceiling.

segments.src: Hitungan ini sederhana dan belum memperhitungkan pergerakan harga atau volume konsumsi, tetapi cukup menggambarkan mengapa isu ini mendapat perhatian.
segments.tr: This calculation is simple and does not factor in price movements or consumption volumes, but it sufficiently illustrates why this issue has garnered attention.

segments.src: > Catatan: kelebihan realisasi atas pagu tidak otomatis berarti defisit melebar. Pemerintah dapat menutupnya lewat realokasi belanja, penggunaan anggaran cadangan, atau penerimaan yang meningkat.
segments.tr: > Note: excess realization over the ceiling does not automatically mean a widening deficit. The government can cover it through spending reallocation, the use of reserve funds, or increased revenues.

segments.src: ## Komponen Subsidi dan Kompensasi Energi
segments.tr: ## Components of Energy Subsidies and Compensation

segments.src: Secara umum, beban energi dalam APBN terbagi dua jenis.
segments.tr: In general, the energy burden in the State Budget is divided into two types.

segments.src: Subsidi energi**, yaitu belanja yang secara eksplisit dianggarkan dan dibayarkan pemerintah.
segments.tr: Energy subsidies**, which are expenditures explicitly budgeted and paid for by the government.

segments.src: Komponen utamanya:
segments.tr: Their main components:

segments.src: - **BBM tertentu**, seperti solar dan minyak tanah, yang dijual dengan harga lebih rendah dari harga keekonomiannya. Untuk solar, subsidi dihitung sebagai selisih tetap per liter.
segments.tr: - **Specific subsidized fuels**, such as diesel and kerosene, which are sold at prices lower than their economic cost. For diesel, the subsidy is calculated as a fixed difference per liter.

segments.src: - **LPG tabung 3 kilogram**, yang disalurkan untuk rumah tangga dan usaha mikro dengan harga eceran yang ditetapkan.
segments.tr: - **3-kilogram LPG cylinders**, which are distributed to households and micro-enterprises at a set retail price.

segments.src: - **Listrik bersubsidi**, yang menyasar golongan pelanggan tertentu, terutama rumah tangga kecil.
segments.tr: - **Subsidized electricity**, which targets specific customer groups, especially small households.

segments.src: Kompensasi energi**, yaitu pembayaran kepada badan usaha, terutama PT Pertamina (Persero) dan PT PLN (Persero).
segments.tr: Energy compensation**, which are payments to business entities, notably PT Pertamina (Persero) and PT PLN (Persero).

segments.src: Kompensasi muncul ketika harga jual eceran lebih rendah dari harga keekonomian, tetapi tidak masuk kategori subsidi.
segments.tr: Compensation arises when the retail selling price is lower than the economic cost, but does not fall into the subsidy category.

segments.src: Contohnya BBM jenis penugasan seperti Pertalite, serta selisih tarif listrik yang ditahan.
segments.tr: Examples include assigned fuel types such as Pertalite, as well as withheld electricity tariff differentials.

segments.src: Perbedaan ini penting.
segments.tr: This distinction is important.

segments.src: Subsidi sudah punya pagu yang jelas, sedangkan kompensasi lebih sensitif terhadap perubahan harga pasar karena nilainya mengikuti selisih antara harga keekonomian dan harga jual.
segments.tr: Subsidies already have a clear ceiling, whereas compensation is more sensitive to market price changes because its value follows the difference between the economic price and the selling price.

segments.src: ## Mengapa ICP Menjadi Faktor Kunci
segments.tr: ## Why ICP is a Key Factor

segments.src: ICP merupakan acuan harga minyak mentah Indonesia yang dipakai dalam asumsi dasar ekonomi makro.
segments.tr: The ICP serves as the benchmark for Indonesian crude oil prices used in macroeconomic assumptions.

segments.src: Asumsi US$70 per barel berarti seluruh perhitungan subsidi dan kompensasi dalam pagu disusun pada tingkat harga tersebut.
segments.tr: An assumption of US$70 per barrel means all subsidy and compensation calculations within the ceiling are formulated at that price level.

segments.src: Ketika ICP bergerak ke sekitar US$112, selisihnya mencapai sekitar US$42 per barel, atau kira-kira 60 persen di atas asumsi.
segments.tr: When the ICP moves to around US$112, the difference reaches approximately US$42 per barrel, or roughly 60 percent above the assumption.

segments.src: Dampaknya terasa pada beberapa jalur:
segments.tr: The impact is felt across several channels:

segments.src: - **Harga keekonomian BBM naik.** Selama harga eceran ditahan, selisih yang harus ditanggung negara membesar.
segments.tr: - **The economic price of fuel rises.** As long as retail prices are held steady, the gap that the state must bear widens.

segments.src: - **Harga LPG ikut terdorong.** Harga LPG dipengaruhi harga acuan internasional yang umumnya bergerak searah dengan energi lain.
segments.tr: - **LPG prices are also pushed up.** LPG prices are influenced by international benchmark prices which generally move in tandem with other energies.

segments.src: - **Biaya pembangkitan listrik berubah.** Sebagian pembangkit masih bergantung pada bahan bakar minyak dan gas, walaupun batu bara dan energi terbarukan memiliki porsi yang besar.
segments.tr: - **Power generation costs change.** Some power plants still rely on fuel oil and gas, although coal and renewable energy hold a large share.

segments.src: ## Faktor Kurs: Ketika Rupiah Melemah
segments.tr: ## Exchange Rate Factor: When the Rupiah Weakens

segments.src: Harga minyak dan LPG dibayar dalam dolar AS, sedangkan APBN disusun dalam rupiah.
segments.tr: Oil and LPG prices are paid in US dollars, while the State Budget is formulated in rupiah.

segments.src: Pelemahan rupiah membuat setiap dolar yang harus dibayar menjadi lebih mahal.
segments.tr: The depreciation of the rupiah makes every dollar that must be paid more expensive.

segments.src: Jadi, kenaikan ICP dan pelemahan kurs bekerja bersamaan, bukan sendiri-sendiri.
segments.tr: Thus, the increase in ICP and the weakening exchange rate work together, not independently.

segments.src: Gambaran sederhananya: biaya energi dalam rupiah kira-kira merupakan perkalian harga dolar dengan kurs.
segments.tr: Simply put: energy costs in rupiah are roughly the product of the dollar price and the exchange rate.

segments.src: Jika harga naik 60 persen dan kurs ikut melemah beberapa persen, kenaikan biaya dalam rupiah akan lebih besar daripada kenaikan harga dolarnya saja.
segments.tr: If prices rise by 60 percent and the exchange rate also weakens by a few percentage points, the increase in costs in rupiah will be greater than the increase in dollar prices alone.

segments.src: ## Sensitivitas APBN: Tidak Hanya Soal Belanja
segments.tr: ## State Budget Sensitivity: Not Just About Spending

segments.src: Banyak orang hanya melihat sisi belanja, padahal APBN memiliki dua sisi.
segments.tr: Many people only look at the expenditure side, even though the State Budget has two sides.

segments.src: **Sisi belanja** bertambah karena subsidi dan kompensasi naik, seperti dijelaskan di atas.
segments.tr: **The expenditure side** increases because subsidies and compensation rise, as explained above.

segments.src: **Sisi penerimaan** sebagian ikut terdongkrak.
segments.tr: **The revenue side** is partially boosted.

segments.src: Harga minyak yang lebih tinggi meningkatkan penerimaan negara bukan pajak (PNBP) dari sumber daya alam migas, pajak penghasilan migas, serta dana bagi hasil ke daerah.
segments.tr: Higher oil prices increase non-tax state revenue (PNBP) from oil and gas natural resources, oil and gas income tax, and revenue-sharing funds for regions.

segments.src: Kurs yang lemah juga menambah nilai rupiah dari penerimaan berbasis dolar.
segments.tr: A weak exchange rate also increases the rupiah value of dollar-based revenues.

segments.src: Karena Indonesia kini lebih banyak mengimpor minyak daripada mengekspornya, dampak bersih kenaikan harga minyak umumnya cenderung menekan APBN.
segments.tr: Since Indonesia now imports more oil than it exports, the net impact of rising oil prices generally tends to pressure the State Budget.

segments.src: Tambahan penerimaan tidak sepenuhnya mengimbangi tambahan beban subsidi.
segments.tr: Additional revenue does not fully offset the additional subsidy burden.

segments.src: Besarnya selisih ini berubah dari tahun ke tahun dan dipengaruhi volume lifting, porsi impor, serta kebijakan harga.
segments.tr: The magnitude of this gap changes from year to year and is influenced by lifting volumes, import portions, and pricing policies.

segments.src: Pemerintah biasanya menyajikan sensitivitas ini dalam dokumen nota keuangan dan laporan semester.
segments.tr: The government usually presents this sensitivity in financial note documents and semester reports.

segments.src: Selain itu, pelemahan rupiah juga menambah beban pembayaran bunga dan pokok utang valuta asing.
segments.tr: In addition, the depreciation of the rupiah also increases the burden of foreign currency debt interest and principal payments.

segments.src: Efek ini terpisah dari energi, tetapi tetap menekan ruang fiskal secara keseluruhan.
segments.tr: This effect is separate from energy, but still pressures overall fiscal space.

segments.src: ## Pilihan Kebijakan bagi Pemerintah
segments.tr: ## Policy Options for the Government

segments.src: Ada beberapa opsi, dengan konsekuensi masing-masing.
segments.tr: There are several options, each with its own consequences.

segments.src: Pemerintah umumnya memadukan lebih dari satu.
segments.tr: The government generally combines more than one.

segments.src: Menahan harga dan menambah anggaran.** Cara ini menjaga daya beli dan inflasi, tetapi memperbesar belanja dan defisit.
segments.tr: Maintaining prices and increasing the budget.** This approach preserves purchasing power and inflation, but enlarges spending and the deficit.

segments.src: Konsekuensinya, kebutuhan pembiayaan melalui utang bisa meningkat.
segments.tr: Consequently, financing needs through debt may increase.

segments.src: Realokasi belanja.** Pemerintah dapat menggeser pos yang serapannya rendah atau menunda belanja yang tidak mendesak untuk menutup kenaikan beban energi.
segments.tr: Spending reallocation.** The government can shift posts with low absorption rates or delay non-urgent spending to cover the increased energy burden.

segments.src: Ruang ini terbatas dan perlu hati-hati agar tidak mengganggu layanan publik.
segments.tr: This space is limited and must be handled carefully so as not to disrupt public services.

segments.src: Menyesuaikan harga secara bertahap.** Penyesuaian harga BBM atau tarif akan mengurangi tekanan fiskal, tetapi berisiko mendorong inflasi dan menurunkan daya beli, terutama bagi kelompok berpendapatan rendah.
segments.tr: Adjusting prices gradually.** Adjusting fuel prices or tariffs will reduce fiscal pressure, but risks driving inflation and lowering purchasing power, especially for low-income groups.

segments.src: Biasanya kebijakan ini disertai bantalan sosial.
segments.tr: Usually, this policy is accompanied by social cushions.

segments.src: Memperketat sasaran penerima.** Subsidi yang lebih tepat sasaran, misalnya lewat pendataan penerima LPG 3 kg atau pembatasan konsumsi solar dan Pertalite, dapat menekan volume tanpa menaikkan harga bagi semua orang.
segments.tr: Tightening target recipients.** Subsidies that are more targeted, for example through better data collection for 3 kg LPG recipients or limiting the consumption of diesel and Pertalite, can reduce volume without raising prices for everyone.

segments.src: Tantangannya ada pada kualitas data dan pengawasan di lapangan.
segments.tr: The challenge lies in data quality and on-the-ground supervision.

segments.src: Bauran energi dan efisiensi.** Dalam jangka menengah, pemanfaatan biodiesel, kendaraan listrik, kompor induksi, dan energi terbarukan dapat mengurangi ketergantungan pada impor.
segments.tr: Energy mix and efficiency.** In the medium term, the use of biodiesel, electric vehicles, induction stoves, and renewable energy can reduce import dependency.

segments.src: Hasilnya tidak instan, tetapi memperkecil sensitivitas APBN terhadap harga minyak di masa depan.
segments.tr: The results are not instant, but they minimize the State Budget's sensitivity to future oil prices.

segments.src: Pengelolaan risiko.** Instrumen seperti lindung nilai (*hedging*), pengelolaan cadangan devisa, dan koordinasi dengan Bank Indonesia membantu meredam gejolak kurs.
segments.tr: Risk management.** Instruments such as hedging, foreign exchange reserve management, and coordination with Bank Indonesia help curb exchange rate volatility.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## What to Watch Going Forward

segments.src: Beberapa hal layak dipantau hingga akhir tahun:
segments.tr: Several things are worth monitoring until the end of the year:

segments.src: - **Arah harga minyak dunia.** Jika ICP bertahan tinggi, tekanan pada kuartal terakhir akan semakin besar. Jika turun, beban dapat mereda.
segments.tr: - **The direction of global oil prices.** If the ICP remains high, pressure in the final quarter will be even greater. If it drops, the burden may ease.

segments.src: - **Pergerakan rupiah.** Kurs yang stabil membantu menahan kenaikan biaya.
segments.tr: - **Rupiah movements.** A stable exchange rate helps curb cost increases.

segments.src: - **Volume konsumsi.** Konsumsi BBM dan LPG yang melebihi kuota akan menambah beban di luar faktor harga.
segments.tr: - **Consumption volume.** Fuel and LPG consumption exceeding quotas will add burdens beyond price factors.

segments.src: - **Sinyal dari pemerintah.** Penjelasan resmi mengenai laporan semester, outlook akhir tahun, dan rancangan anggaran tahun berikutnya akan menunjukkan arah kebijakan.
segments.tr: - **Signals from the government.** Official explanations regarding semester reports, year-end outlooks, and the following year's budget drafts will indicate the direction of policy.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Realisasi subsidi dan kompensasi energi sebesar Rp376,8 triliun hingga September, atau 84,3 persen dari pagu, menunjukkan bahwa tekanan harga minyak dan kurs sudah nyata dalam postur belanja negara.
segments.tr: The realization of energy subsidies and compensation of Rp376.8 trillion through September, or 84.3 percent of the ceiling, shows that the pressure of oil prices and exchange rates is real in the state expenditure posture.

segments.src: Selisih ICP sekitar US$112 per barel terhadap asumsi US$70 menjadi pendorong utama, diperkuat oleh nilai tukar rupiah.
segments.tr: The ICP gap of about US$112 per barrel against the US$70 assumption is the main driver, reinforced by the rupiah exchange rate.

segments.src: Meski begitu, APBN tidak sepenuhnya rapuh.
segments.tr: Even so, the State Budget is not entirely fragile.

segments.src: Penerimaan dari migas ikut naik, dan pemerintah memiliki sejumlah instrumen untuk menyeimbangkan anggaran.
segments.tr: Revenues from oil and gas have also risen, and the government has a number of instruments to balance the budget.

segments.src: Pertanyaan utamanya bukan hanya seberapa besar bebannya, melainkan bagaimana pemerintah menjaga keseimbangan antara daya beli masyarakat, disiplin fiskal, dan transisi energi dalam jangka panjang.
segments.tr: The main question is not just how heavy the burden is, but how the government maintains a balance between public purchasing power, fiscal discipline, and long-term energy transition.

id-20261017-news-3.title: BI Predicts Rise in Inflation Pressure in November 2026: Which Goods Are Most Vulnerable to Price Hikes and How Households Can Prepare

segments.src: Survei Konsumen Bank Indonesia (BI) untuk September 2026 menunjukkan dua hal yang sekilas tampak bertolak belakang.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia's (BI) Consumer Survey for September 2026 reveals two seemingly contradictory findings.

segments.src: Di satu sisi, keyakinan konsumen masih optimis dengan Indeks Keyakinan Konsumen (IKK) di level **118,1**, jauh di atas ambang 100 yang menandai optimisme.
segments.tr: On one hand, consumer confidence remains optimistic with the Consumer Confidence Index (IKK) at **118.1**, well above the threshold of 100 which marks optimism.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, ekspektasi masyarakat terhadap harga umum meningkat untuk **November 2026** dan **Februari 2027**.
segments.tr: On the other hand, public expectations regarding general prices increase for **November 2026** and **February 2027**.

segments.src: Artinya, konsumen masih percaya diri terhadap kondisi ekonomi, tetapi mulai bersiap menghadapi harga yang lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: This means consumers still feel confident about economic conditions, but are starting to brace themselves for higher prices.

segments.src: Artikel ini membahas arti survei tersebut, faktor yang bisa mendorong kenaikan harga, kelompok barang yang rawan, dan langkah praktis untuk menjaga anggaran keluarga.
segments.tr: This article discusses the meaning of the survey, factors that could drive price increases, vulnerable goods categories, and practical steps to maintain family budgets.

segments.src: > Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informasi umum dan bukan nasihat keuangan atau investasi. Ekspektasi dalam survei adalah persepsi responden, bukan ramalan resmi angka inflasi.
segments.tr: > Note: This article is for general informational purposes and is not financial or investment advice. Expectations in the survey are respondents' perceptions, not an official forecast of inflation figures.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Sebenarnya Diukur Survei BI?
segments.tr: ## What Does the BI Survey Actually Measure?

segments.src: Survei Konsumen BI dilakukan secara berkala untuk menangkap persepsi rumah tangga terhadap kondisi ekonomi, penghasilan, lapangan kerja, dan harga.
segments.tr: The BI Consumer Survey is conducted periodically to capture household perceptions of economic conditions, income, employment, and prices.

segments.src: Dua hal perlu dibedakan:
segments.tr: Two things need to be distinguished:

segments.src: - **Indeks Keyakinan Konsumen (IKK):** gambaran seberapa optimis konsumen terhadap kondisi ekonomi saat ini dan beberapa bulan ke depan. Nilai di atas 100 berarti optimis. IKK 118,1 pada September 2026 menunjukkan optimisme yang masih terjaga.
segments.tr: - **Consumer Confidence Index (IKK):** an overview of how optimistic consumers are about current and upcoming economic conditions. A value above 100 means optimism. The IKK of 118.1 in September 2026 shows that optimism is still maintained.

segments.src: - **Ekspektasi harga:** perkiraan responden tentang arah harga barang dan jasa pada periode mendatang. Kenaikan indeks ini berarti lebih banyak responden memperkirakan harga naik.
segments.tr: - **Price expectations:** respondents' estimates about the direction of goods and services prices in the coming period. An increase in this index means more respondents expect prices to rise.

segments.src: Ekspektasi harga penting karena bisa memengaruhi perilaku.
segments.tr: Price expectations are important because they can influence behavior.

segments.src: Jika orang menduga harga akan naik, sebagian akan membeli lebih awal, pedagang lebih berani menaikkan harga, dan pekerja menuntut kenaikan upah.
segments.tr: If people expect prices to rise, some will buy earlier, merchants will be bolder in raising prices, and workers will demand wage hikes.

segments.src: Karena itu bank sentral mencermatinya sebagai salah satu sinyal untuk menjaga inflasi tetap terkendali.
segments.tr: Therefore, the central bank monitors this as one of the signals to keep inflation under control.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Keyakinan Tinggi tetapi Ekspektasi Harga Naik?
segments.tr: ## Why Is Confidence High but Price Expectations Rising?

segments.src: Keduanya tidak saling meniadakan.
segments.tr: The two do not negate each other.

segments.src: Rumah tangga bisa merasa pendapatannya cukup aman dan lapangan kerja terjaga, tetapi tetap melihat harga kebutuhan harian merangkak naik.
segments.tr: Households can feel their income is secure enough and employment is maintained, while still seeing the prices of daily necessities creeping up.

segments.src: Menjelang akhir tahun, pola ini juga cukup lazim karena permintaan musiman meningkat.
segments.tr: Toward the end of the year, this pattern is also quite common as seasonal demand increases.

segments.src: Optimisme yang tinggi malah dapat menopang belanja, sehingga tekanan permintaan terhadap harga ikut terjaga.
segments.tr: High optimism can actually support spending, keeping demand pressure on prices intact.

segments.src: ## Pendorong Kenaikan Harga yang Perlu Dicermati
segments.tr: ## Price Hike Drivers to Watch

segments.src: Beberapa faktor berikut umumnya menjadi penentu pergerakan harga di Indonesia.
segments.tr: The following factors generally determine price movements in Indonesia.

segments.src: Dampak ketiganya bergantung pada perkembangan di lapangan.
segments.tr: The impact of all three depends on developments on the ground.

segments.src: ### 1. Energi
segments.tr: ### 1. Energy

segments.src: Harga energi, termasuk bahan bakar, elpiji, dan tarif listrik, memengaruhi biaya transportasi dan produksi.
segments.tr: Energy prices, including fuel, LPG, and electricity tariffs, affect transportation and production costs.

segments.src: Perubahan harga minyak dunia atau kebijakan harga energi dalam negeri bisa merembet ke ongkos angkut dan harga barang lain dengan jeda waktu tertentu.
segments.tr: Changes in world oil prices or domestic energy price policies can spill over into shipping costs and the prices of other goods with a certain time lag.

segments.src: ### 2. Pangan
segments.tr: ### 2. Food

segments.src: Pangan, terutama bahan pokok dan komoditas bergejolak (*volatile food*) seperti beras, cabai, bawang, telur, dan minyak goreng, biasanya paling cepat terasa bagi rumah tangga.
segments.tr: Food, especially staple goods and volatile commodities (*volatile food*) such as rice, chili, shallots, eggs, and cooking oil, is usually felt fastest by households.

segments.src: Cuaca, musim tanam dan panen, gangguan distribusi, serta lonjakan permintaan saat hari besar keagamaan dan libur akhir tahun dapat mendorong harga naik.
segments.tr: Weather, planting and harvesting seasons, distribution disruptions, and surges in demand during religious holidays and year-end vacations can drive prices up.

segments.src: ### 3. Nilai Tukar Rupiah
segments.tr: ### 3. Rupiah Exchange Rate

segments.src: Pelemahan rupiah membuat harga barang impor dan barang yang bahan bakunya diimpor menjadi lebih mahal.
segments.tr: The weakening of the rupiah makes imported goods and goods with imported raw materials more expensive.

segments.src: Contohnya elektronik, suku cadang kendaraan, sebagian bahan pangan olahan, obat dan bahan baku industri.
segments.tr: Examples include electronics, vehicle spare parts, some processed food ingredients, medicines, and industrial raw materials.

segments.src: Produsen kerap meneruskan kenaikan biaya itu ke konsumen secara bertahap.
segments.tr: Producers often pass those cost increases on to consumers gradually.

segments.src: ### 4. Faktor Musiman
segments.tr: ### 4. Seasonal Factors

segments.src: Akhir tahun identik dengan peningkatan permintaan: libur sekolah, perjalanan, perayaan, dan belanja promo.
segments.tr: The end of the year is synonymous with increased demand: school holidays, travel, celebrations, and promo shopping.

segments.src: Tarif transportasi, tiket, dan akomodasi cenderung naik pada periode tersebut.
segments.tr: Transportation rates, tickets, and accommodations tend to rise during this period.

segments.src: ## Barang dan Jasa yang Paling Rawan Mahal
segments.tr: ## Goods and Services Most Vulnerable to Price Hikes

segments.src: Berdasarkan faktor di atas, kelompok berikut layak dipantau.
segments.tr: Based on the above factors, the following groups are worth monitoring.

segments.src: Ini gambaran risiko umum, bukan jaminan harga akan naik.
segments.tr: This is a general risk picture, not a guarantee that prices will rise.

segments.src: | Kelompok | Alasan rawan naik | Contoh |
segments.tr: | Group | Reason vulnerable to increases | Examples |

segments.src: | Pangan bergejolak | Cuaca, distribusi, permintaan musiman | Cabai, bawang, telur, daging ayam, sayuran |
segments.tr: | Volatile food | Weather, distribution, seasonal demand | Chili, shallots, eggs, chicken meat, vegetables |

segments.src: | Bahan pokok | Biaya produksi dan pasokan | Beras, minyak goreng, gula |
segments.tr: | Staple goods | Production costs and supply | Rice, cooking oil, sugar |

segments.src: | Transportasi dan perjalanan | Biaya energi dan lonjakan permintaan libur | Tiket, ongkos angkutan, tarif akomodasi |
segments.tr: | Transportation and travel | Energy costs and holiday demand surges | Tickets, transport fares, accommodation rates |

segments.src: | Barang impor | Pengaruh nilai tukar | Elektronik, gawai, suku cadang |
segments.tr: | Imported goods | Exchange rate influence | Electronics, gadgets, spare parts |

segments.src: | Energi rumah tangga | Harga energi dan kebijakan tarif | Elpiji, bahan bakar, listrik |
segments.tr: | Household energy | Energy prices and tariff policies | LPG, fuel, electricity |

segments.src: ## Langkah Praktis Rumah Tangga Menghadapi Kenaikan Harga
segments.tr: ## Practical Household Steps to Face Price Increases

segments.src: ### 1. Tinjau Ulang Anggaran Bulanan
segments.tr: ### 1. Review Monthly Budgets

segments.src: Catat pengeluaran satu hingga dua bulan terakhir, lalu pisahkan antara **kebutuhan** (pangan, listrik, transportasi, cicilan, pendidikan) dan **keinginan**.
segments.tr: Record expenses for the past one to two months, then separate between **needs** (food, electricity, transportation, installments, education) and **wants**.

segments.src: Beri ruang tambahan pada pos yang paling mungkin naik, misalnya pangan dan transportasi.
segments.tr: Give extra room to categories most likely to rise, such as food and transportation.

segments.src: ### 2. Siapkan Dana Darurat
segments.tr: ### 2. Prepare an Emergency Fund

segments.src: Idealnya dana darurat setara tiga sampai enam bulan pengeluaran pokok, disimpan di instrumen yang mudah dicairkan dan berisiko rendah.
segments.tr: Ideally, an emergency fund is equivalent to three to six months of basic expenses, kept in easily liquidable and low-risk instruments.

segments.src: Jika belum mencapai angka itu, mulailah dengan menyisihkan jumlah kecil secara rutin.
segments.tr: If you have not reached that figure, start by setting aside small amounts regularly.

segments.src: ### 3. Belanja Lebih Cerdas
segments.tr: ### 3. Shop Smarter

segments.src: - Buat daftar belanja mingguan dan patuhi daftar itu.
segments.tr: - Make a weekly shopping list and stick to it.

segments.src: - Bandingkan harga di beberapa tempat, termasuk pasar tradisional dan toko daring.
segments.tr: - Compare prices in several places, including traditional markets and online stores.

segments.src: - Beli bahan tahan lama seperti beras, gula, dan minyak dalam jumlah wajar saat harga stabil. **Jangan menimbun**, karena itu bisa memperburuk kenaikan harga dan merugikan orang lain.
segments.tr: - Buy long-lasting ingredients like rice, sugar, and oil in reasonable amounts when prices are stable. **Do not hoard**, as that can worsen price increases and harm others.

segments.src: - Pilih bahan pangan musiman yang harganya relatif lebih murah, dan gunakan pengganti bila ada komoditas yang melonjak (misalnya, bumbu atau sayur alternatif).
segments.tr: - Choose seasonal food ingredients that are relatively cheaper, and use substitutes if any commodity spikes (for example, alternative seasonings or vegetables).

segments.src: ### 4. Kurangi Pemborosan Pangan dan Energi
segments.tr: ### 4. Reduce Food and Energy Waste

segments.src: Simpan makanan dengan benar, olah sisa makanan, matikan peralatan listrik yang tidak dipakai, dan rapikan rute perjalanan.
segments.tr: Store food properly, process leftovers, turn off unused electrical appliances, and tidy up travel routes.

segments.src: Penghematan kecil yang konsisten terasa dalam beberapa bulan.
segments.tr: Consistent small savings add up over a few months.

segments.src: ### 5. Hati-Hati dengan Utang Konsumtif
segments.tr: ### 5. Beware of Consumptive Debt

segments.src: Saat harga naik, cicilan dan bunga tinggi bisa membebani.
segments.tr: When prices rise, high installments and interest can become a burden.

segments.src: Hindari menambah utang untuk belanja konsumtif, dahulukan pelunasan utang berbunga tinggi, dan jangan tergiur pinjaman daring ilegal.
segments.tr: Avoid adding debt for consumptive spending, prioritize paying off high-interest debt, and do not be tempted by illegal online loans.

segments.src: ### 6. Rencanakan Pembelian Besar dan Perjalanan Lebih Awal
segments.tr: ### 6. Plan Major Purchases and Travel Early

segments.src: Untuk liburan akhir tahun, pesan tiket dan penginapan lebih awal bila memungkinkan.
segments.tr: For year-end holidays, book tickets and lodging early if possible.

segments.src: Barang impor yang tidak mendesak bisa ditunda atau dibandingkan harganya lebih dulu, terutama saat nilai tukar bergejolak.
segments.tr: Non-urgent imported goods can be postponed or compared in price first, especially when exchange rates are volatile.

segments.src: ### 7. Jaga dan Tingkatkan Pendapatan
segments.tr: ### 7. Maintain and Increase Income

segments.src: Pertimbangkan menambah keterampilan atau penghasilan sampingan yang realistis.
segments.tr: Consider adding realistic skills or side income.

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha kecil, tinjau harga pokok dan komunikasikan penyesuaian harga secara terbuka kepada pelanggan.
segments.tr: For small business owners, review basic costs and communicate price adjustments openly to customers.

segments.src: ## Peran Kebijakan dan Pemerintah Daerah
segments.tr: ## The Role of Policy and Local Government

segments.src: Pengendalian inflasi melibatkan banyak pihak.
segments.tr: Inflation control involves many parties.

segments.src: BI mengelola kebijakan moneter dan stabilitas nilai tukar, sementara pemerintah pusat dan daerah menjaga pasokan dan distribusi pangan melalui operasi pasar, kerja sama antardaerah, dan pemantauan harga.
segments.tr: BI manages monetary policy and exchange rate stability, while the central and local governments maintain food supply and distribution through market operations, inter-regional cooperation, and price monitoring.

segments.src: Pantau informasi harga dari sumber resmi agar tidak termakan kabar yang belum tentu benar.
segments.tr: Monitor price information from official sources so you do not fall for unverified news.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Survei BI menunjukkan konsumen Indonesia masih optimis dengan IKK September 2026 di 118,1, tetapi juga mengantisipasi harga yang lebih tinggi untuk November 2026 dan Februari 2027.
segments.tr: The BI survey shows Indonesian consumers remain optimistic with the September 2026 IKK at 118.1, but are also anticipating higher prices for November 2026 and February 2027.

segments.src: Kenaikan itu bisa dipengaruhi energi, pangan, dan nilai tukar, ditambah faktor musiman akhir tahun.
segments.tr: Those increases could be influenced by energy, food, and exchange rates, compounded by year-end seasonal factors.

segments.src: Rumah tangga tidak perlu panik.
segments.tr: Households do not need to panic.

segments.src: Dengan anggaran yang tertata, dana darurat, belanja yang bijak, dan kewaspadaan terhadap utang konsumtif, tekanan harga dapat dikelola.
segments.tr: With organized budgets, emergency funds, wise spending, and vigilance against consumptive debt, price pressures can be managed.

segments.src: Ingat bahwa angka survei mencerminkan persepsi, jadi pantau rilis resmi BI dan Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) untuk data inflasi terbaru.
segments.tr: Remember that survey figures reflect perceptions, so monitor official releases from BI and the Central Bureau of Statistics (BPS) for the latest inflation data.

id-20261017-intro-logistics-14.title: [Logistics #14] If You Don't Measure It, Don't Expect to Fix It

segments.src: > Rantai pasok yang sehat berdiri di atas tiga hal: beberapa angka yang benar-benar penting (KPI), satu bahasa bersama untuk membandingkannya (model SCOR), dan kesiapan menghadapi hal yang tidak Anda rencanakan (manajemen risiko) — plus jejak karbon yang kini ikut dihitung.
segments.tr: > A healthy supply chain stands on three things: a handful of numbers that truly matter (KPIs), one shared language for comparing them (the SCOR model), and readiness for what you didn't plan for (risk management) — plus a carbon footprint, which now also gets counted.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Tiga belas sesi sebelumnya berbicara soal *menjalankan* logistik: membeli, menyimpan, mengangkut, mengirim.
segments.tr: The previous thirteen sessions talked about *running* logistics: buying, storing, transporting, shipping.

segments.src: Sesi ini soal *menilai* apakah semua itu berjalan baik — dan apa yang terjadi kalau tiba-tiba tidak.
segments.tr: This session is about *assessing* whether all of that is working well — and what happens when, suddenly, it isn't.

segments.src: KPI: sedikit angka, tapi angka yang tepat**
segments.tr: KPIs: few numbers, but the right ones**

segments.src: Godaan terbesar dalam pengukuran adalah mengukur segalanya.
segments.tr: The biggest temptation in measurement is measuring everything.

segments.src: Dashboard dengan 40 metrik biasanya berarti tidak ada satu pun yang benar-benar diperhatikan.
segments.tr: A dashboard with 40 metrics usually means none of them is actually paid attention to.

segments.src: Praktik yang lazim adalah memilih beberapa indikator dari tiga keluarga:
segments.tr: The common practice is to pick a few indicators from three families:

segments.src: - **Layanan** — janji Anda kepada pelanggan. Yang paling terkenal adalah **OTIF** (*On Time In Full*): pesanan datang tepat waktu **dan** lengkap.
segments.tr: - **Service** — your promise to customers. The best known is **OTIF** (*On Time In Full*): orders arrive on time **and** complete.

segments.src: OTIF = (pesanan tepat waktu DAN lengkap) / total pesanan x 100%
segments.tr: OTIF = (pesanan tepat waktu DAN lengkap) / total pesanan x 100%

segments.src: Perhatikan kata "dan".
segments.tr: Notice the word "and".

segments.src: Kalau 95% pesanan tepat waktu dan 95% lengkap, OTIF Anda bisa jatuh ke sekitar 90%.
segments.tr: If 95% of orders are on time and 95% are complete, your OTIF can drop to around 90%.

segments.src: Pelanggan tidak merasakan dua angka terpisah; mereka merasakan hasil gabungannya.
segments.tr: Customers don't feel two separate numbers; they feel the combined result.

segments.src: - **Biaya** — biaya logistik per pesanan, atau biaya logistik sebagai persen dari penjualan.
segments.tr: - **Cost** — logistics cost per order, or logistics cost as a percentage of sales.

segments.src: - **Aset dan kas** — perputaran persediaan, dan **cash-to-cash cycle time**: berapa hari uang Anda "terjebak" di antara membayar pemasok dan menerima uang dari pelanggan.
segments.tr: - **Assets and cash** — inventory turnover, and the **cash-to-cash cycle time**: how many days your money is "stuck" between paying suppliers and receiving payment from customers.

segments.src: Cash-to-cash = hari persediaan + hari piutang - hari utang
segments.tr: Cash-to-cash = hari persediaan + hari piutang - hari utang

segments.src: Kunci membacanya: **KPI harus dibaca berpasangan.** OTIF 99,5% yang dicapai dengan menumpuk stok tiga kali lipat bukan prestasi, itu pemindahan masalah dari gudang pelanggan ke gudang sendiri.
segments.tr: The key to reading them: **KPIs must be read in pairs.** An OTIF of 99.5% achieved by stockpiling three times the inventory is not an achievement; it's moving the problem from the customer's warehouse to your own.

segments.src: Satu angka layanan selalu perlu didampingi satu angka biaya atau kas.
segments.tr: A service number should always be accompanied by at least one cost or cash number.

segments.src: SCOR: bahasa bersama untuk rantai pasok**
segments.tr: SCOR: a shared language for supply chains

segments.src: Masalah klasik: gudang Anda menyebutnya "akurasi pengiriman", pemasok Anda menyebutnya "service level", dan keduanya menghitung dengan rumus berbeda.
segments.tr: The classic problem: your warehouse calls it "shipping accuracy", your supplier calls it "service level", and both calculate with different formulas.

segments.src: Model **SCOR** (*Supply Chain Operations Reference*) dibuat untuk itu — sebuah kamus standar yang dikembangkan asosiasi profesi rantai pasok (kini ASCM).
segments.tr: The **SCOR** model (*Supply Chain Operations Reference*) was created for exactly that — a standard dictionary developed by the supply chain professional association (now ASCM).

segments.src: SCOR memecah rantai pasok menjadi proses inti — klasiknya **Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return**, ditambah *Enable* untuk fungsi pendukung — lalu menempelkan metrik baku pada setiap proses.
segments.tr: SCOR breaks the supply chain into core processes — classically **Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, Return**, plus *Enable* for supporting functions — and then attaches standard metrics to each process.

segments.src: Versi terbarunya (SCOR Digital Standard) menata ulang penamaan proses tersebut dan memberi porsi lebih besar untuk isu keberlanjutan.
segments.tr: The latest version (SCOR Digital Standard) reorganizes the naming of these processes and gives greater weight to sustainability issues.

segments.src: Yang paling berguna untuk pemula adalah **lima atribut kinerjanya**:
segments.tr: The most useful part for beginners is its **five performance attributes**:

segments.src: | Atribut | Pertanyaannya | Arah |
segments.tr: | Attribute | The question | Direction |

segments.src: | Reliability | Apakah janji ditepati? | Menghadap pelanggan |
segments.tr: | Reliability | Are promises kept? | Customer-facing |

segments.src: | Responsiveness | Seberapa cepat? | Menghadap pelanggan |
segments.tr: | Responsiveness | How fast? | Customer-facing |

segments.src: | Agility | Sanggup berubah kalau permintaan melonjak/anjlok? | Menghadap pelanggan |
segments.tr: | Agility | Can you adapt when demand surges or drops? | Customer-facing |

segments.src: | Cost | Berapa biayanya? | Menghadap ke dalam |
segments.tr: | Cost | What does it cost? | Internal-facing |

segments.src: | Asset Management | Seberapa irit modal & persediaan? | Menghadap ke dalam |
segments.tr: | Asset Management | How efficiently is capital & inventory used? | Internal-facing |

segments.src: Tiga atribut pertama dilihat pelanggan; dua terakhir dilihat pemilik dan investor.
segments.tr: The first three are seen by customers; the last two are seen by owners and investors.

segments.src: Strategi rantai pasok pada dasarnya adalah keputusan atribut mana yang Anda kejar lebih dulu — tidak ada perusahaan yang juara di kelimanya sekaligus.
segments.tr: A supply chain strategy is essentially the decision about which attributes to pursue first — no company is the champion of all five at once.

segments.src: Risiko: bukan soal ramalan, tapi soal kesiapan**
segments.tr: Risk: not about prediction, but about readiness

segments.src: Peta risiko paling sederhana punya dua sumbu:
segments.tr: The simplest risk map has two axes:

segments.src: Skor risiko = kemungkinan x dampak
segments.tr: Skor risiko = kemungkinan x dampak

segments.src: Dari situ risiko biasanya dipilah dua:
segments.tr: From there, risks are usually sorted into two types:

segments.src: - **Risiko operasional** — sering terjadi, dampak kecil: truk telat, selisih stok, dokumen salah. Diselesaikan dengan proses dan penyangga (buffer) rutin.
segments.tr: - **Operational risk** — happens often, small impact: late trucks, stock discrepancies, wrong documents. Handled by routine processes and buffers.

segments.src: - **Risiko disruptif** — jarang, dampak besar: banjir, kebakaran gudang, pemasok tunggal bangkrut, pelabuhan tersendat. Tidak bisa diselesaikan dengan buffer harian; butuh rencana.
segments.tr: - **Disruptive risk** — rare, large impact: floods, warehouse fires, a sole supplier going bankrupt, port congestion. Cannot be solved with daily buffers; requires a plan.

segments.src: Ada dua angka yang sangat praktis untuk risiko disruptif:
segments.tr: There are two numbers that are very practical for disruptive risk:

segments.src: - **TTR** (*Time to Recover*) — berapa lama sebuah titik (pemasok, pabrik, gudang) butuh untuk pulih kalau lumpuh.
segments.tr: - **TTR** (*Time to Recover*) — how long a point (supplier, factory, warehouse) needs to recover if it is knocked out.

segments.src: - **TTS** (*Time to Survive*) — berapa lama Anda masih bisa melayani pelanggan tanpa titik itu.
segments.tr: - **TTS** (*Time to Survive*) — how long you can still serve customers without that point.

segments.src: **Kalau TTS lebih pendek dari TTR, di situlah titik lemah Anda.** Cara ini menarik karena tidak menuntut Anda meramal *kapan* bencana datang — cukup mengukur seberapa tahan Anda kalau datang.
segments.tr: **If TTS is shorter than TTR, that's where your weak point is.** This approach is appealing because it doesn't require you to predict *when* a disaster will come — just to measure how well you hold up if it does.

segments.src: Penawarnya standar: sumber ganda (*dual sourcing*), stok pengaman di titik strategis (bukan di semua titik), kontrak yang fleksibel, dan visibilitas sampai pemasok lapis kedua.
segments.tr: The standard remedies: dual sourcing, safety stock at strategic points (not at all points), flexible contracts, and visibility down to second-tier suppliers.

segments.src: Logistik berkelanjutan: metrik yang baru ikut masuk daftar**
segments.tr: Sustainable logistics: a newly added metric

segments.src: Semakin banyak pembeli korporat dan pasar ekspor meminta data emisi, biasanya dalam satuan **gram CO₂ per ton-kilometer** (standar yang umum dipakai: kerangka GLEC).
segments.tr: More and more corporate buyers and export markets are asking for emissions data, usually in units of **grams of CO₂ per ton-kilometer** (a commonly used standard: the GLEC framework).

segments.src: Kabar baiknya, sebagian besar langkah penurunannya juga menurunkan biaya: konsolidasi muatan, mengurangi truk yang pulang kosong (*backhaul*), memindahkan sebagian volume dari truk ke kereta atau kapal, dan merampingkan kemasan.
segments.tr: The good news is that most reduction steps also lower costs: consolidating loads, reducing empty return trips (*backhaul*), shifting part of the volume from trucks to rail or ships, and streamlining packaging.

segments.src: Kabar kurang enaknya: sebagian tidak sejalan — pengiriman ekspres satuan ke rumah pelanggan hampir selalu lebih mahal *dan* lebih boros emisi daripada pengiriman terjadwal.
segments.tr: The less pleasant news: some don't align — single-unit express delivery to a customer's home is almost always more expensive *and* more emissions-intensive than scheduled delivery.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Everyday Practice

segments.src: Bu Sari punya usaha kopi bubuk kemasan di Bandung.
segments.tr: Ms. Sari runs a packaged ground coffee business in Bandung.

segments.src: Sebulan sekitar 1.000 pesanan: marketplace ke seluruh Jawa, dan kiriman grosir ke kafe di Jakarta, Surabaya, serta Makassar.
segments.tr: She sends about 1,000 orders a month: via marketplaces across Java, and bulk shipments to cafés in Jakarta, Surabaya, and Makassar.

segments.src: **Tahap 1 — pasang KPI.** Selama ini ia hanya melihat omzet.
segments.tr: **Stage 1 — set KPIs.** Until now she had only looked at revenue.

segments.src: Setelah tiga bulan mencatat, angkanya:
segments.tr: After three months of recording, the numbers were:

segments.src: - OTIF: **88%** (dari 1.000 pesanan, 120 telat atau kurang isi)
segments.tr: - OTIF: **88%** (of 1,000 orders, 120 were late or short)

segments.src: - Biaya logistik: **Rp 18.000 per pesanan** (ongkir + kemasan + tenaga packing)
segments.tr: - Logistics cost: **Rp 18,000 per order** (shipping + packaging + packing labor)

segments.src: - Perputaran persediaan: **6x setahun** — artinya rata-rata stok mengendap dua bulan
segments.tr: - Inventory turnover: **6x a year** — meaning average stock sits for two months

segments.src: **Tahap 2 — baca berpasangan.** Reaksi pertamanya: "kejar OTIF ke 98%."
segments.tr: **Stage 2 — read in pairs.** Her first reaction: "push OTIF to 98%."

segments.src: Tapi begitu ia hitung, menambah stok penyangga di semua SKU akan menaikkan modal tertahan sekitar Rp 40 juta dan memperburuk perputaran.
segments.tr: But once she calculated it, adding buffer stock across all SKUs would tie up roughly Rp 40 million more capital and worsen turnover.

segments.src: Setelah dipilah, ternyata 70% keterlambatan hanya berasal dari **tiga SKU** dan **rute Makassar**.
segments.tr: After sorting, it turned out 70% of the delays came from just **three SKUs** and the **Makassar route**.

segments.src: Menambah stok pada tiga SKU itu saja mengangkat OTIF ke sekitar 95% dengan tambahan modal jauh lebih kecil.
segments.tr: Adding stock for those three SKUs alone raised OTIF to around 95% with much less additional capital.

segments.src: Ini persis logika SCOR: ia menaikkan *reliability* dengan mengorbankan *asset management efficiency* seminimal mungkin — sebuah keputusan sadar, bukan kebetulan.
segments.tr: This is exactly the SCOR logic: she raised *reliability* while sacrificing *asset management efficiency* as little as possible — a deliberate decision, not a coincidence.

segments.src: **Tahap 3 — cek risiko.** Seluruh biji kopinya berasal dari **satu** koperasi petani di Garut.
segments.tr: **Stage 3 — check risk.** All of her coffee beans came from **one** farmers' cooperative in Garut.

segments.src: Ia hitung: kalau koperasi itu berhenti memasok, butuh sekitar **6 minggu** untuk mendapat pemasok baru dengan profil rasa yang mirip (TTR = 6 minggu), sementara stok bijinya hanya cukup **2 minggu** (TTS = 2 minggu).
segments.tr: She calculated that if that cooperative stopped supplying, it would take about **6 weeks** to find a new supplier with a similar flavor profile (TTR = 6 weeks), while her bean stock would last only **2 weeks** (TTS = 2 weeks).

segments.src: TTS < TTR — ini titik lemahnya, dan tidak ada di laporan keuangan mana pun.
segments.tr: TTS < TTR — this is her weak point, and it doesn't appear in any financial report.

segments.src: Solusinya bukan menimbun biji setahun, melainkan mengualifikasi satu koperasi cadangan di Gunung Puntang dan membeli 15% volume dari sana secara rutin, agar hubungan dan resepnya sudah teruji sebelum dibutuhkan.
segments.tr: The solution is not to hoard a year's worth of beans, but to qualify a backup cooperative in Gunung Puntang and buy 15% of the volume from there routinely, so the relationship and the recipe are already tested before they're needed.

segments.src: Untuk rute Makassar, risikonya beda jenis: pengapalan lewat pelabuhan bisa tersendat, dan menjelang Lebaran arus barang melonjak.
segments.tr: For the Makassar route, the risk is of a different kind: shipments through the port can get stuck, and ahead of Eid the flow of goods surges.

segments.src: Ia menetapkan aturan sederhana: kiriman Makassar dikirim satu batch lebih awal setiap menjelang periode padat.
segments.tr: She set a simple rule: Makassar shipments go out one batch earlier before each busy period.

segments.src: **Tahap 4 — sisi keberlanjutan.** Sebuah jaringan kafe yang menjadi kliennya mulai menanyakan data emisi pengiriman.
segments.tr: **Stage 4 — the sustainability side.** A café chain that is her client began asking for shipping emissions data.

segments.src: Bu Sari menemukan bahwa menggabungkan kiriman Jakarta dari tiga kali seminggu menjadi dua kali seminggu dengan muatan penuh menurunkan ongkos angkut per kilogram **sekaligus** emisi per kilogram.
segments.tr: Ms. Sari found that consolidating Jakarta shipments from three times a week to twice a week with full loads lowered the transport cost per kilogram **and** the emissions per kilogram at the same time.

segments.src: Satu perubahan, dua KPI membaik — sementara permintaan kliennya soal "kirim tiap hari" ia tolak dengan data, bukan dengan perasaan.
segments.tr: One change, two KPIs improved — and she rejected her client's request to "ship every day" with data, not with feelings.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Pilih sedikit KPI yang mewakili layanan, biaya, dan kas — lalu baca berpasangan, karena menaikkan satu hampir selalu menekan yang lain.
segments.tr: 1. Pick a few KPIs that represent service, cost, and cash — then read them in pairs, because raising one almost always pressures another.

segments.src: 2. Model SCOR memberi kamus dan metrik baku untuk proses rantai pasok, dengan lima atribut kinerja: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, dan asset management efficiency.
segments.tr: 2. The SCOR model provides a dictionary and standard metrics for supply chain processes, with five performance attributes: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost, and asset management efficiency.

segments.src: 3. Manajemen risiko bukan meramal bencana, melainkan mengukur ketahanan — bandingkan TTS dengan TTR, dan perkuat titik yang TTS-nya lebih pendek.
segments.tr: 3. Risk management isn't about predicting disasters, but about measuring resilience — compare TTS with TTR, and strengthen the points where TTS is shorter.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah perusahaan mencatat 96% pesanan datang tepat waktu dan 94% pesanan datang lengkap.
segments.tr: **1.** A company records that 96% of orders arrived on time and 94% of orders arrived complete.

segments.src: Apa yang bisa disimpulkan tentang OTIF-nya?
segments.tr: What can be concluded about its OTIF?

segments.src: - (A) OTIF-nya pasti 96%
segments.tr: - (A) Its OTIF is definitely 96%

segments.src: - (B) OTIF-nya pasti 95% (rata-rata keduanya)
segments.tr: - (B) Its OTIF is definitely 95% (the average of the two)

segments.src: - (C) OTIF-nya lebih rendah dari 94%, karena satu pesanan harus memenuhi kedua syarat sekaligus
segments.tr: - (C) Its OTIF is lower than 94%, because a single order must meet both conditions at once

segments.src: - (D) OTIF tidak berhubungan dengan kedua angka itu
segments.tr: - (D) OTIF has no relationship to those two numbers

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Menaikkan tingkat layanan (misalnya OTIF) selalu menguntungkan perusahaan, karena pelanggan lebih puas.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) Raising the service level (e.g., OTIF) is always beneficial to the company, because customers are happier.

segments.src: **3.** Gudang Anda punya stok cukup untuk 3 minggu tanpa pasokan dari pemasok utama, sementara pemasok itu diperkirakan butuh 8 minggu untuk pulih dari gangguan besar.
segments.tr: **3.** Your warehouse has enough stock for 3 weeks without supply from your main supplier, while that supplier is expected to need 8 weeks to recover from a major disruption.

segments.src: Apa artinya?
segments.tr: What does this mean?

segments.src: - (A) Aman, karena stok tiga minggu sudah di atas standar industri
segments.tr: - (A) Safe, because three weeks of stock is already above the industry standard

segments.src: - (B) TTS (3 minggu) lebih pendek dari TTR (8 minggu) — ada celah 5 minggu yang perlu ditutup
segments.tr: - (B) TTS (3 weeks) is shorter than TTR (8 weeks) — there is a 5-week gap that needs to be closed

segments.src: - (C) TTR lebih penting daripada TTS, jadi cukup pantau pemasok saja
segments.tr: - (C) TTR matters more than TTS, so it's enough to just monitor the supplier

segments.src: - (D) Cukup diselesaikan dengan menaikkan KPI biaya logistik
segments.tr: - (D) It can be solved simply by raising the logistics cost KPI

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **KPI (Key Performance Indicator)** — sedikit indikator terpilih yang dipakai menilai apakah proses berjalan sesuai tujuan, bukan sekadar daftar semua angka yang bisa dihitung.
segments.tr: - **KPI (Key Performance Indicator)** — a small set of selected indicators used to assess whether a process is running in line with its goals, not simply a list of every number that can be calculated.

segments.src: - **OTIF (On Time In Full)** — persentase pesanan yang tiba tepat waktu **dan** lengkap; ukuran janji ke pelanggan yang paling ketat dan paling sering dipakai.
segments.tr: - **OTIF (On Time In Full)** — the percentage of orders that arrive on time **and** complete; the strictest and most frequently used measure of the promise to customers.

segments.src: - **Model SCOR** — kerangka acuan standar rantai pasok (kini dikelola ASCM) yang memberi nama proses, metrik, dan lima atribut kinerja yang sama untuk semua perusahaan.
segments.tr: - **SCOR model** — a standard supply chain reference framework (now managed by ASCM) that provides the same process names, metrics, and five performance attributes for all companies.

segments.src: - **TTR / TTS (Time to Recover / Time to Survive)** — berapa lama sebuah titik rantai pasok butuh untuk pulih, versus berapa lama Anda sanggup bertahan tanpanya; selisihnya menunjukkan letak kerapuhan.
segments.tr: - **TTR / TTS (Time to Recover / Time to Survive)** — how long a supply chain point needs to recover, versus how long you can survive without it; the difference shows where the fragility lies.

segments.src: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — jumlah hari antara uang keluar ke pemasok dan uang masuk dari pelanggan; makin pendek, makin sedikit modal kerja yang terkunci di rantai pasok.
segments.tr: - **Cash-to-cash cycle time** — the number of days between money going out to suppliers and money coming in from customers; the shorter it is, the less working capital is locked up in the supply chain.

segments.src: *Jawaban: **1 — (C).** OTIF menuntut satu pesanan memenuhi dua syarat sekaligus, sehingga hasilnya berada di bawah angka terendah dari keduanya (bukan rata-ratanya).
segments.tr: *Answers: **1 — (C).** OTIF requires one order to meet two conditions at once, so the result falls below the lower of the two numbers (not their average).

segments.src: **2 — X.** Layanan yang lebih tinggi hampir selalu ditebus dengan stok, ruang gudang, atau ongkos kirim ekspres yang lebih mahal; karena itu KPI layanan wajib dibaca bersama KPI biaya dan kas.
segments.tr: **2 — F.** Higher service is almost always paid for with stock, warehouse space, or more expensive express shipping; that's why service KPIs must be read together with cost and cash KPIs.

segments.src: **3 — (B).** TTS (3 minggu) < TTR (8 minggu) berarti Anda kehabisan napas lima minggu sebelum pemasok pulih — celahnya ditutup dengan sumber cadangan, stok strategis, atau kesepakatan pemulihan yang lebih cepat.*
segments.tr: **3 — (B).** TTS (3 weeks) < TTR (8 weeks) means you run out of breath five weeks before the supplier recovers — the gap is closed with backup sources, strategic stock, or faster recovery agreements.*
